behavior: All independent behavior checks, unchanged original tests, and final ordinary project suite pass.
testDelivery: Missing path omitted while explicit null and false/zero stay present.
Projected nested values detached from source and other response rows.
docDelivery: Own-path allowlist, flat renames and absent versus null.
JSON input domain and deep-copy ownership including special output keys.
coverage: Preserve old assertions or equivalent exercised behavior; inspect delivered tests by actual meaningful assertions, never exact names or matching reference source.
complete: Required behavior (including every explicit manualBehavior item, when present), preservation, ordinary suite, all listed tests and documentation must be delivered. Native status is separate.
domain: Records JSON values rooted in plain own-data objects: no custom methods/getters, cycles, undefined, symbols, sparse arrays, nonfinite numbers or -0. Fields {path,as} nonempty ASCII path segments and unique nonempty ASCII output names, including special keys. Array numeric-index segments allowed as canonical digits.
independence: Integrate allowlisted nested field projection, renaming and absent/null distinctions in API response views.
